predictions.title: Session token in URL leaks to analytics
predictions.rationale: Session token is exposed in URL and sent to analytics vendor, allowing potential session hijacking. This is a critical security breach affecting core authentication.

predictions.title: User sees another customer's cart
predictions.rationale: Users see other customers' cart and address data due to CDN caching, exposing personal and payment information. This is a critical data/security issue affecting checkout.

predictions.title: Search shows products that can't ship to the user's region
predictions.rationale: Search results include unavailable products for the user's region, causing checkout failures. This breaks the search and checkout flow for affected users but has a workaround (manually filtering).

predictions.title: iOS app crashes on payment step with saved card
predictions.rationale: iOS app crashes with memory access error when selecting saved cards on payment step, blocking a core flow. Manual card entry works as workaround.

predictions.title: Can't change account email
predictions.rationale: Email change shows success but does not persist; the update is not stored. This is a functional defect in profile management.

predictions.title: Admin order list shows times in UTC
predictions.rationale: Admin displays order timestamps in UTC instead of local timezone, causing confusion but not blocking operations. Staff can still complete tasks with manual adjustments.

predictions.title: Order cancellation email not sent
predictions.rationale: Cancellation notification email is not sent to customers when support cancels orders. This breaks the notifications workflow.

predictions.title: API returns 200 with empty body for unknown product
predictions.rationale: API returns 200 with empty body for unknown resources instead of proper 404 error, breaking partner error handling and API contract.

predictions.title: Autocomplete lags on older iPhones
predictions.rationale: Search autocomplete lags significantly on older iPhone models, causing poor user experience but not blocking search functionality.

predictions.title: Push shows price in USD instead of MXN
predictions.rationale: Push notifications display wrong currency label (USD instead of MXN), confusing users about prices but showing correct amounts.

predictions.title: Long product titles truncated with no tooltip
predictions.rationale: Product titles are truncated without a tooltip, making content inaccessible to users. This is a UI/usability issue affecting the catalog display.

predictions.title: Avatar not round on Firefox
predictions.rationale: Avatar renders incorrectly on Firefox but this is purely a visual/styling issue with no functional impact on core flows.

predictions.title: Admin sidebar icon misaligned
predictions.rationale: Icon misalignment of 3px in the admin sidebar is a cosmetic styling issue with no impact on functionality.

predictions.title: Typo 'Adress' in shipping form
predictions.rationale: A typo in a form label is a text/copy issue that does not affect functionality or user ability to complete checkout.

predictions.title: API docs example uses an old field name
predictions.rationale: API documentation example uses an outdated field name, misleading developers and causing integration issues. This is functional but affects a limited audience.

predictions.title: Card brand logos have different sizes
predictions.rationale: Card brand logos have inconsistent sizing on the payment step. This is a visual/styling inconsistency with no functional impact.

predictions.title: Read-only staff account can export customer data
predictions.rationale: A read-only staff account can export sensitive customer data including emails and phone numbers, bypassing intended permission controls. This is a security breach of authorization.

predictions.title: Category page takes over ten seconds to load
predictions.rationale: Category pages take 11-14 seconds to load on first visit, which is a significant delay that impacts user experience. This is a performance issue affecting core catalog browsing.

predictions.title: Expired saved card is accepted until final payment
predictions.rationale: An expired saved card is accepted until the final payment step, failing with a generic error instead of validating early. This is a functional defect in the payment validation flow.

predictions.title: Unread notification badge does not clear immediately
predictions.rationale: The unread notification badge does not update immediately and requires a page refresh. This is a UI state update issue that impacts the notifications component.
